errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies 2016 as the year with the lowest total area of dessert vineyards (blue bar). According to the chart, the value for 2016 is approximately 2500 hectares, while the value for 2022 is lower, at approximately 2450 hectares.

The description states that the harvested area (orange bars) ranges up to 2100 hectares, but the chart shows values exceeding this in several years, most notably in 2015 (approx. 2250 hectares) and 2022 (approx. 2200 hectares).

The description claims that the highest harvested area was in 2020. However, the chart shows that the highest value for the orange bars is in 2015 (approx. 2250 hectares), which is visibly higher than the value for 2020 (approx. 2150 hectares).
